## Description
Briefly describe the proposed Advisor or enhancements.

## Type of Change
- [ ] New Advisor proposal
- [ ] Refinement to existing Advisor (`SKILL.md`)
- [ ] Expansion of reference knowledge base (`references/`)
- [ ] Documentation update (`README.md` / `README_ZH.md`)

## Checklist
- [ ] Conforms to the Three-Level Progressive Disclosure model.
- [ ] `SKILL.md` is written in canonical English and kept under 150 lines.
- [ ] Includes an Operating Boundaries section stating what the advisor defers to.
- [ ] Core ideological conflicts in the domain are explicitly arbitrated.
- [ ] `references/` contains distilled summaries, not reproductions, and each file is linked from `SKILL.md`.
- [ ] Includes a pre-delivery verification checklist.
- [ ] Tested locally against the cases in `evals/trigger-cases.md` with at least one major Agent (Claude Code / Cursor / Codex / Antigravity).
- [ ] `node scripts/validate_skills.mjs` passes.
